summary: This topic explains how to define bus routes, assign vehicles to routes, specify pick-up and drop points with timings and charges, and assign drivers. It also covers copying routes from previous sessions and bulk uploading pick-up points via Excel.
steps: Enter the 'Name of the route' (e.g., Route 1).
Select the 'Vehicle' that runs on this route from the dropdown.
Optionally, select 'Skip Installment' months if transport fees should be skipped for specific installments (e.g., June for schools).
Optionally, enter 'Longitude' and 'Latitude' for GPS tracking.
Click 'Add' to save the pick-up point. Repeat for multiple pick-up points.
To copy routes from a previous session:
Select the desired previous session from the dropdown.
To update existing pick-up points or add new ones to an existing route:
Add or modify pick-up points as needed.
To upload pick-up points in bulk via Excel:
Fill the Excel with 'Pick-up Point Name', 'Amount', 'Pick-up Time', 'Drop Time', 'Longitude', and 'Latitude'.
business_rules: Transport fees can be skipped for specific installments.
Employee data for drivers is sourced from the HRM employee setup.
important_notes: 'Copy from Session' is useful when routes remain similar across academic sessions.
Pick-up Time and Drop Time are mandatory when adding manually but non-mandatory for Excel upload.
If there are errors during Excel upload (e.g., missing mandatory data), the system will generate an error file.
